summary_en: 180,000 shares (1.13% of outstanding) to be acquired for max ¥300M via open-market purchase, Aug 10–Oct 30, 2026. Shares to be allocated under restricted-stock compensation plans (executive and senior staff performance-conditioned awards). Dilution mitigation for existing shareholders.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares (Acquisition of own shares pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act and the Articles of Incorporation, Article 37)
translation_en_brief: Global Link Management's board authorized on August 7, 2026 the acquisition of up to 180,000 shares (1.13% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a maximum of ¥300M via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 10 and October 30, 2026. The company will hold the acquired shares to support two restricted-stock compensation schemes: a basic grant program for directors and executive officers, and a performance-conditioned deferred-grant program for executives and senior staff designed to strengthen commitment toward earnings targets. The stated purpose is to preserve existing shareholders' ownership percentages while securing shares for future awards under these equity compensation plans. The share count represents 1.13% of the 15,973,896 shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026 (excluding 69,620 shares then held in treasury). Execution is subject to market conditions; partial or no acquisition may occur.
